Secure door circuit: valid card A and correct PIN B feed OR; that output and building open C feed AND; lockdown D feeds NOT; both results enter the final AND to produce Q.
Printer circuit. A and B feed an OR gate. C feeds a NOT gate. The OR and NOT outputs feed a final AND gate to make Q.
Half adder with inputs A and B both one; XOR produces sum zero and AND produces carry one
Full adder built from two half adders: A and B enter the first half adder; its sum S1 and CarryIn enter the second half adder; carry C1 and C2 are combined using an OR gate to produce CarryOut
